name: Landcare Action Grants (Landcare Tasmania)
summary: Devolved Tasmanian Government grants, delivered by Landcare Tasmania to its members, for on-ground work such as weed control, fencing and invasive species management on high conservation value land and waterways.

amount.note: Up to $40,000 for exceptional projects, as judged by the assessment panel

reporting: Progress report due October-November 2026; final report and financial acquittal due April 2027

status.quote: Apply now: Applications are now closed.

applicant_types.quote: Eligible applicants include all types of Landcare Tasmania members: Community Care Group* Individual Associate (farm, school, business, aboriginal organisation, club or association, trust, government entity)**

geography.quote: Landcare Action Grants 2026: Protecting, Enhancing, and Maintaining Tasmania's Natural Values

access.quote: To be eligible to apply for the grant, you must be a member of Landcare Tasmania.

window.quote: applications open 2nd December 2025 Applications close 31st Jan 2026

amount.quote: The preferred project funding amount is $5,000 to $20,000 (ex. GST) per project, with up to $40,000 (ex. GST) available for exceptional projects as determined by the assessment panel.

administered_by.quote: Landcare Tasmania has been a major delivery partner of the Landcare Action Grants with the Tasmanian Government since 2018.

reporting.quote: Progress report October - November 2026 Project works completion date April 2027 Final report and financial acquittal due April 2027
